description:
Title: Service for Your Fridge

Your fridge produces strange noises.
You describe the symptoms, and send them together with the type of fridge to the central fridge service center.
They select a local service facility (which all have their own way of interacting with customers).
The service facility makes an appointment.
They arrive at a random time, and sometimes have to leave without repairing your fridge, because they need additional parts.
After your fridge is repaired, you have to confirm that it is OK again.
You can rate the service facility.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  id="Definitions_ServiceForYourFridge"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/service-for-your-fridge">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SymptomsAndFridgeType" name="Symptoms and fridge type"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Symptoms" name="Symptoms and fridge type" sourceRef="Task_SendSymptoms" targetRef="Start_CenterReceivesRequest" messageRef="Message_SymptomsAndFridgeType"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceRequest" name="Service request" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRequest" targetRef="Start_FacilityReceivesRequest" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Appointment" name="Appointment" sourceRef="Task_SendAppointment" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAppointment" messageRef="Message_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FacilityArrival" name="Service facility arrival" sourceRef="Task_ArriveAtCustomer" targetRef="Event_FacilityArrives" messageRef="Message_FacilityArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairCompleted" name="Repair completed" sourceRef="Task_SendRepairCompletion" targetRef="Event_RepairCompleted" messageRef="Message_RepairCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_UnableToRepair" name="Unable to repair because additional parts are needed" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="Event_UnableToRepair" messageRef="Message_UnableToRepair"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">

    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DescribeSymptoms" name="Describe symptoms and identify fridge type">

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSymptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type to the central fridge service center">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAppointment" name="Receive appointment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FacilityArrives" name="Service facility arrives">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FacilityArrival" messageRef="Message_FacilityArrival"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForServiceOutcome" name="Wait for service outcome" gatewayDirection="Diverging" eventGatewayType="Exclusive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_7</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_6</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RepairCompleted" messageRef="Message_RepairCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_UnableToRepair" name="Facility leaves without repairing because additional parts are needed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_UnableToRepair" messageRef="Message_UnableToRepair"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK" name="Confirm fridge is OK again">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RateFacility" name="Choose whether to rate the service facility" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_Customer_12">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerRated" name="Service confirmed and facility rated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerNoRating" name="Service confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_12</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerNoRepair" name="Fridge not repaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_FridgeNoises" targetRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms" targetRef="Task_SendSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SendSymptoms" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAppointment" targetRef="Event_FacilityArrives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Event_FacilityArrives" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForServiceOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForServiceOutcome" targetRef="Event_RepairCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForServiceOutcome" targetRef="Event_UnableToRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_8" sourceRef="Event_RepairCompleted" targetRef="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" sourceRef="Event_UnableToRepair" targetRef="End_CustomerNoRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK" targetRef="Gateway_RateFacility"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerChoosesToRate</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_12" name="Do not rate" sourceRef="Gateway_RateFacility" targetRef="End_CustomerNoRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_13" sourceRef="Task_RateFacility" targetRef="End_CustomerRated"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CentralServiceCenter" name="Central fridge service center" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CenterReceivesRequest" name="Receive symptoms and fridge type">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Center_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CenterRequest" messageRef="Message_SymptomsAndFridgeType"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFacility" name="Select a local service facility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Center_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Center_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendServiceRequest" name="Send service request to the selected local service facility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Center_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Center_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CenterRequestSent" name="Local service facility selected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Center_3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_1" sourceRef="Start_CenterReceivesRequest" targetRef="Task_SelectFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectFacility" targetRef="Task_SendServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_3" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRequest" targetRef="End_CenterRequestSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ServiceFacility" name="Local service facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FacilityReceivesRequest" name="Receive service request">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Facility_1</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Facility_1</bpmn:incoming>

    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAppointment" name="Send appointment to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Facility_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Facility_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArriveAtCustomer" name="Arrive at the customer's location at a random time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Facility_3</bpmn:incoming>

    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Facility_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Facility_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Facility_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repairing the fridge because additional parts are needed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Facility_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Facility_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FacilityUnableToRepair" name="Left without repairing the fridge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Facility_7</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairFridge" name="Repair the fridge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Facility_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Facility_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRepairCompletion" name="Notify customer that the fridge has been repaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Facility_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Facility_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FacilityRepairCompleted" name="Fridge repaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Facility_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_1" sourceRef="Start_FacilityReceivesRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_2" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="Task_SendAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_3" sourceRef="Task_SendAppointment" targetRef="Task_ArriveAtCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_4" sourceRef="Task_ArriveAtCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_5" name="Additional parts needed" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalParts" targetRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">additionalPartsNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_6" name="No additional parts needed" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalParts" targetRef="Task_RepairFridge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_7" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="End_FacilityUnableToRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_8" sourceRef="Task_RepairFridge" targetRef="Task_SendRepairCompletion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_9" sourceRef="Task_SendRepairCompletion" targetRef="End_FacilityRepairCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
